title.zh: 【Aave V3 和 V4 所有市场已解冻，USDT、USDC 等资产暂不可作为新借款抵押品】
title.en: 【Aave V3 和 V4 所有市场已解冻，USDT、USDC 等资产暂不可作为新借款抵押品】

current_state.zh: Aave has unfrozen all V3 and V4 markets while keeping loan-to-value at zero for USDT, USDC, and several other assets, preventing them from being used as new borrowing collateral as a precaution after the Binance hack reports.
current_state.en: Aave has unfrozen all V3 and V4 markets while keeping loan-to-value at zero for USDT, USDC, and several other assets, preventing them from being used as new borrowing collateral as a precaution after the Binance hack reports.
